anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: Grande Roche Hotel: Historic Cape Dutch Luxury in the Heart of Paarl Winelands
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Experience unhurried luxury at Grande Roche Hotel, a historic Cape Dutch estate nestled in the picturesque Paarl Winelands. Our serene retreat offers elegant suites, award-winning dining at Bosman's Restaurant, and breathtaking vineyard and mountain views. Guests can unwind by the outdoor pool, explore manicured gardens, or enjoy a sundowner at Winnifred's Bar. Perfectly situated for exploring local wineries and culinary gems, Grande Roche provides a tranquil escape where gracious living meets the vibrant culture of the Western Cape. Discover a truly authentic Winelands experience, loved by locals and discerning travelers alike.
